AboutPage.title: A Guide-Led Project Built in Prague
AboutPage.subtitle: Pragolem was created by two certified guides who wanted to combine historical depth, practical clarity, and honest human contact on every route.

story.title: Our story
story.paragraph1: Pragolem started from a simple observation: many tours in Prague were either too superficial or too rigid. We wanted a format where guests could understand the city in context while still enjoying a relaxed and personal atmosphere.
story.paragraph2: Today we guide in English and French across the Old Town, Prague Castle area, and private formats. Every itinerary is designed to help visitors leave with both concrete orientation and a deeper understanding of Czech history.

guides.title: Lucas and Nathan
guides.subtitle: The two co-founders guiding Pragolem tours on the ground.

philosophy.title: How we guide
philosophy.body: Our tours follow three principles that shape every explanation, recommendation, and route decision.

accuracy.title: Historical accuracy
accuracy.body: We prioritize verified context over dramatic simplifications so visitors can trust what they hear.

human.title: Human delivery
human.body: We adapt pace, examples, and detail level to the group in front of us, not to a fixed script.

clarity.title: Practical clarity
clarity.body: We give useful orientation and local advice that stays relevant after the tour is over.

meta.title: Terms & Conditions | Pragolem Tours
meta.description: Read the terms and conditions for Pragolem Tours bookings, cancellations, and tour participation in Prague.

general.title: 1. General Information
general.body: Pragolem Tours operates guided walking tours in Prague, Czech Republic. By booking a tour or using our website, you agree to the following terms and conditions. These terms apply to all services offered through pragolem.com.

booking.title: 2. Booking and Reservations
booking.body: Tour reservations are subject to availability and confirmation by our team. A booking request does not guarantee a confirmed spot until you receive a confirmation email. We reserve the right to modify or cancel tours due to weather, safety, or operational reasons. In such cases, we will offer an alternative date or a full refund.

freeModel.title: 3. Walkinkg Tour Payment Model
freeModel.body: Our walking tours operate on a pay-what-you-wish basis. There is no fixed fee and no obligation to pay. Guests decide on a contribution at the end of the tour based on their experience and budget. This model relies on trust and mutual respect between guides and participants.

privateTours.title: 4. Private Tours and Pricing
privateTours.body: Private tour pricing is provided on a per-request basis and depends on group size, duration, and itinerary complexity. A quote will be sent after your booking request. Payment terms and cancellation conditions for private tours are communicated at the time of confirmation.

cancellation.title: 5. Cancellation Policy
cancellation.body: walkinkg tour bookings can be cancelled at any time without charge. We appreciate advance notice so we can plan accordingly. Private tour cancellations must be communicated at least 48 hours before the scheduled start time. Late cancellations may be subject to a cancellation fee as outlined in your booking confirmation.

liability.title: 6. Liability
liability.body: Pragolem Tours takes reasonable precautions to ensure guest safety during all tours. However, participation in walking tours is at your own risk. We are not liable for personal injuries, theft, loss of property, or damages arising during the tour. Travel insurance is recommended for all participants.

privacy.title: 7. Privacy and Data
privacy.body: Personal information collected through booking forms is used solely for tour organization and communication purposes. We do not sell or share your data with third parties. For questions about data handling, contact us at info@pragolem.com.

intellectual.title: 8. Intellectual Property
intellectual.body: All content on this website, including text, images, logos, and tour descriptions, is the property of Pragolem Tours. Reproduction or redistribution without written permission is prohibited.

modifications.title: 9. Modifications
modifications.body: Pragolem Tours reserves the right to update these terms at any time. Changes take effect upon publication on this page. Continued use of our services after updates constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.body: For questions about these terms, reach us at info@pragolem.com or through the contact form on our website.
